Drink it for Bast's Blessing (1 minute), then sleep in a bed: the ancestors will test you on the Ancestral Plane. Pass, and you become the Black Panther (it replaces your Primary power).
message.projecthero.black_panther.vision: The herb burns through you, and Bast's Blessing settles on you. Sleep in a bed within the minute: the ancestors will call you.
message.projecthero.black_panther.blesse: Bast's Blessing is already upon you. Sleep.
message.projecthero.ancestral_plane.wand: Your ancestors are waiting. Walk to them.
message.projecthero.ancestral_plane.shri: Lay your hand on the Panther Shrine: right-click the statue or the altar.
message.projecthero.ancestral_plane.tria: The Trial of the Shades: strike every shade before it strikes you.
message.projecthero.ancestral_plane.roun: The shades overwhelm you. Breathe, and rise again.
message.projecthero.ancestral_plane.park: The spirit path: climb to the sunset. Checkpoints catch your falls.
message.projecthero.ancestral_plane.wake: You wake in your bed. The plane slips away, and the herb's gift with it: you will need another soup.
You wake in your bed, but the Panther's power could not be given to you.
subtitle.projecthero.ancestral_plane.tit: Where the kings and queens of old wait beneath the sunset
subtitle.projecthero.ancestral_plane.gre: Child of the Panther. We felt your footsteps on this grass long before you came.
%s. The herb opened the way and sleep carried you here, to the ones who walked before you.
But the mantle is never simply given. It is earned. Bast herself will look into your heart.
Come. Walk with us to her shrine.
subtitle.projecthero.ancestral_plane.pro: Long before the first king, the Panther Goddess walked this grass and chose a guardian for her people.
Each of us once stood where you will stand. Lay your hand upon her shrine when you are ready.
subtitle.projecthero.ancestral_plane.int: Another heart comes to my shrine, asking for the strength of the Panther.
First, my shades. They hunt as I hunt. Meet them, and do not let them reach you.
They will come three times. Steady your breath.
subtitle.projecthero.ancestral_plane.pat: Your hands are quick. Now show me your feet are sure. Climb the spirit path to the sun.
subtitle.projecthero.ancestral_plane.fin: It is done. Your heart did not break, and your feet did not falter.
Rise, Black Panther. Guard your people, and never forget the ones who walked before you.
We are always with you, %s. Now wake.
hud.projecthero.ancestral_plane.wander: Walk to your ancestors under the great acacia
hud.projecthero.ancestral_plane.shrine: Right-click the Panther Shrine's statue or altar
hud.projecthero.ancestral_plane.wake_hin: Hold Sneak to wake up early (no power)
projecthero.guide.black_panther.origin.b: Heart-Shaped Herbs are rare glowing purple plants that grow only in jungles. Craft a bowl with 3 herbs into Heart-Shaped Herb Soup and drink it: no power yet, but Bast's Blessing for 1 minute (purple and gold effect). Sleep in a bed while it lasts (by day too: while blessed the bed lets you) and once you fall asleep you wake on the Ancestral Plane, where the ancestors and Bast test you (below). Pass and you wake in your bed as the Black Panther. It replaces your Primary power.
projecthero.guide.black_panther.plane.bo: Your own private dream: an endless golden savanna under a huge orange and purple sunset. You wake a long walk from your ancestors, robed kings and queens waiting under a great acacia; a trail of gold and violet motes leads you. Walk up to them and they greet you, then lead you to the Panther Shrine, a ring of black stone pillars around a great panther statue. Right-click the statue or the altar to be tested. Nothing in the plane can hurt you or be broken, and the cutscenes can be skipped with Space once you have seen them.
projecthero.guide.black_panther.plane.tr: Test 1, the Trial of the Shades: ghostly panthers come for you on the shrine floor, three rounds (4 shades one at a time, then 6, then 8 two at a time). Each one stalks in, crouches with its eyes flaring (that is your warning), then pounces at you. One hit from anything strikes a shade down: hit it as it comes in, as it crouches, or in mid-leap, or step aside. Three pounces landing on you loses the round, and it starts again on the spot.
projecthero.guide.black_panther.plane.pa: Test 2, the spirit path: a 113-block parkour course of floating stones, panther totems and amethyst rising toward the sun behind the shrine. Gold-inlaid checkpoints every 20 blocks or so; fall and the plane catches you and puts you back on the last one, with no damage. Reach the panther head at the end and Bast herself appears.
projecthero.guide.black_panther.plane.le: Hold Sneak for 5 seconds outside a cutscene to wake up early: you go back to your bed with no power and need a new soup. Logging out in the plane does the same.
projecthero.guide.black_panther.commands: /projecthero power grant black_panther [player], /projecthero power tune black_panther kinetic <0-100>. Ancestral Plane test tools: /projecthero power tune black_panther blessing | plane | shrine | trial | path | parkour | finale | leave.
projecthero.jei.heart_shaped_herb_soup: Drink it for Bast's Blessing (1 minute), then sleep in a bed (day or night) while it lasts. You fall asleep into the Ancestral Plane: walk to your ancestors, follow them to the Panther Shrine and right-click the statue to be tested by Bast.
projecthero.jei.heart_shaped_herb_soup2: The test: the Trial of the Shades (three rounds of ghost panthers, strike them before they pounce), then the spirit path (a 113-block parkour climb with checkpoints). Pass both and you wake in bed as the Black Panther. Hold Sneak 5 s to wake early (no power).
